title: Medical Devices - Worldwide
highlights: Revenue in the Medical Devices market is projected to reach US$576.85bn in 2026.
The market's largest market is Cardiology Devices with a projected market volume of US$89.26bn in 2026.
Revenue is expected to show an annual growth rate (CAGR 2026-2031) of 5.54%, resulting in a market volume of US$755.21bn by 2031.
In global comparison, most revenue will be generated United States (US$213.78bn in 2026).
